# aidbox Provider

Manage Aidbox licenses through the Aidbox RPC API. This provider supports Terraform and OpenTofu.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    aidbox = {
      source  = "reiinoldo/aidbox-license"
      version = "~> 0.1"
    }
  }
}

provider "aidbox" {
  # Set AIDBOX_API_TOKEN in the environment instead of hard-coding it here.
  endpoint = "https://aidbox.app/rpc"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) Aidbox RPC API endpoint. Defaults to `https://aidbox.app/rpc`; can also be set with `AIDBOX_ENDPOINT`.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Aidbox API token. Can also be set with the `AIDBOX_API_TOKEN` environment variable.
